name: Image Derivatives
summary: Thumbnails and transforms with EXIF stripping, generated on read and cached, not eagerly on upload.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
env.description: Object Storage endpoint. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Object Storage access key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Object Storage secret key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: IMAGES_DERIVATIVE_BUCKET
env.description: Where derivatives are written. A separate bucket is the safest shape; empty reuses the source bucket, which then requires a disjoint prefix.

env.name: IMAGES_DERIVATIVE_PREFIX
env.description: Prefix for derivatives. Must be provably disjoint from IMAGES_SOURCE_PREFIX when sharing a bucket, or every output retriggers the pipeline.

env.name: IMAGES_MAX_PIXELS
env.description: Maximum source pixel count. The decompression-bomb guard: a 40KB PNG can decode to 30000x30000, which a byte limit does not catch.

env.name: IMAGES_ALLOWED_WIDTHS
env.description: Comma-separated permitted widths. An allowlist, not a range: unbounded widths let a caller generate unlimited distinct derivatives and bill you for each.

env.name: IMAGES_CACHE_CONTROL
env.description: Cache-Control on served derivatives. Long, because content is immutable for a given key and etag.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Required by §5. Detects derivatives whose source is gone -- there are no storage delete events, so orphans are otherwise permanent and you keep paying to store them.

operations.title: GET /i/:key
operations.description: Serve a derivative, generating on a cache miss.

operations.title: POST /reconcile
operations.description: Cron. Mark derivatives whose source is gone.

operations.title: GET /health
operations.description: Liveness and readiness, backed by the block's v_status view.
